exposure: Increased use of telehealth after the emergence of COVID-19
outcome: Primary care physician (PCP) perspectives on the positive impacts of telehealth
Perceived benefits of telehealth for PCPs
Perceived 'silver linings' of telehealth for patients
cohort: The study participants were primary care physicians working at a large Midwestern academic medical center.
finding: PCPs identified three main benefits of using telehealth (demonstrated remote care feasibility, patient gratitude, full payer reimbursement) and perceived three 'silver linings' for patients (easier access, more convenient follow-up, ability to get quick specialty referrals).
